title: Software Development Engineer, WWRR Tech
description:
**Description**
WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. Our goal is to achieve the three zeroes: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon - returns, recommerce, and rentals.
  
  
Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
  
  
As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.
  
  
We are looking for software engineers with 3+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.
  
  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
  
  
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior/Staff Deep Learning Compiler Engineer
description:
Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C++ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems.
  
  
Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Quadric is building the world’s first General-Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU) architecture, bringing high-performance AI, DSP, and ML compute to edge devices. As a
**Deep Learning Compiler Engineer**
, you will design and optimize the compiler stack (MLIR, TVM, LLVM) that bridges state-of-the-art neural network frameworks directly to our proprietary hardware architecture. You'll play a critical role in unlocking peak hardware performance, low latency, and memory efficiency for edge AI workloads.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Deep Learning Compiler Infrastructure & Optimization**

* Design, implement, and maintain compiler optimization passes targeting Quadric’s processor architecture using frameworks like MLIR, Apache TVM, or LLVM.
* Develop lowering pathways from high-level machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) down to optimized low-level kernel code.
* Optimize neural network performance for memory throughput, latency, compute unit utilization, and power consumption.

**Neural Network Model Parsing & Graph Transformation**

* Implement graph-level optimizations, including operator fusion, layout transformation, quantization (INT8/FP16), and memory allocation strategies.
* Analyze novel deep learning model topologies (Transformers, CNNs, Vision-Language Models) and extend compiler support for new operators and primitives.
* Benchmark and profile end-to-end model performance to identify and resolve compiler bottlenecks.

**Hardware-Software Co-Design**

* Collaborate closely with hardware and micro-architecture teams to define instruction set extensions, hardware acceleration features, and compiler requirements.
* Develop software simulators, functional models, and test benches to validate compiler correctness and generated binary performance.
* Participate in hardware bring-up and validation efforts on FPGA and ASIC platforms.

**What Success Looks Like**
Within your first 6–12 months, you'll:
  
  

* Successfully integrate support for key deep learning models (e.g., modern Transformer architectures or Vision models) into Quadric's compiler pipeline.
* Implement custom graph and codegen optimization passes that deliver measurable performance improvements on target benchmarks.
* Partner with the architecture team to influence the next-generation micro-architecture definition through data-driven workload analysis.

**Required**
**What We're Looking For**

* 8 years+ experience alongwith BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience developing deep learning compilers or compiler infrastructures (e.g., MLIR, Apache TVM, LLVM, XLA, TensorRT, or Glow).
* Strong proficiency in C++ (14/17/20) and Python, with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
* Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) and deep learning operator representations.
* Solid understanding of computer systems, memory hierarchies, parallel processing, and CPU/GPU/NPU instruction execution.

**Preferred**

* Experience with low-level kernel optimization, SIMD/vector programming, and memory allocation strategy development.
* Knowledge of model quantization methodologies (INT8, FP8, mixed-precision) and post-training/QAT optimization techniques.
* Prior experience working on software stacks for custom AI accelerators, DSPs, or embedded architectures.
* Experience with FPGA bring-up, hardware emulation, or cycle-accurate simulator development.

Quadric also offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our India-based offerings; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:
  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Equity with the business

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not perfectly match every qualification. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn just as much as direct experience.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, AI Systems
description:
**About Us**

Vectorial AI is a San Francisco-based AI startup building a research-backed behavioral simulation platform with founding team from CMU, Stanford and BITS Pilani.

We help teams test product ideas, creatives, prototypes, messaging, and user decisions using AI-simulated audiences built from real behavioral signals. Our goal is to collapse weeks of user research and experimentation into hours.

We are building at the frontier of AI systems, behavioral simulation, retrieval, evaluation, and product intelligence.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer, AI Systems to help build the core backend and AI systems behind Vectorial.

This is not a pure infra role. It is a product engineering role for someone who can build scalable backend systems, solve hard technical problems, work with AI workflows in production, and bring engineering maturity to a fast-moving startup team.

You should be comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end: understanding the product need, designing the system, breaking down the work, shipping reliably, and improving the system over time.

**You’ll Work On**

* Backend systems for AI-powered simulations, surveys, evaluations, and customer workflows.
* APIs, services, queues, async jobs, cron workflows, and distributed task execution.
* AI workflow orchestration across retrieval, reasoning, model calls, evaluation, and synthesis.
* Reliability, latency, observability, cost optimization, and production debugging.
* Model usage tradeoffs across quality, speed, cost, fallbacks, retries, and rate limits.
* Cloud and DevOps systems across deployment, monitoring, logging, CI/CD, and infrastructure.
* Product-facing systems that need to be fast, reliable, and customer-ready.
* Technical planning and execution support for a young engineering team.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4+ years of backend engineering experience.
* Strong experience building production systems at meaningful scale.
* Deep backend fundamentals: APIs, databases, queues, async jobs, caching, distributed systems, and debugging.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
* Strong DevOps and production operations mindset.
* Practical experience or strong interest in LLMs, AI APIs, RAG, agents, or AI-native products.
* Ability to work through ambiguity and convert messy problems into clear engineering execution.
* Strong ownership, product sense, and technical judgment.
* Comfort working in an early-stage startup where speed and quality both matter.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with production LLM systems, RAG, vector databases, or AI evaluation.
* Experience with orchestration tools like Temporal, Step Functions, Airflow, Celery, Kafka, SQS, or similar.
* Experience with React / Next.js or full-stack product engineering.
* Experience mentoring younger engineers or acting as a technical lead.
* Experience with ML infra, fine-tuning, recommender systems, or agentic workflows.

**Location**

India-based role, working closely with the founding team in San Francisco.

title: Senior Shopify Backend Developer (Node.js, Shopify Plus Apps)
description:
Adella is a US-based ecommerce agency that builds and runs Shopify and Shopify Plus stores for US brands. We are hiring a senior backend engineer to own the server side of those builds: custom apps, integrations, data migrations and checkout logic.

**The basics, up front**

* Full-time and remote from anywhere in India.
* Engage as an independent contractor or as an employee. Tell us which you prefer.
* Competitive pay, paid monthly in INR.
* Working hours: 4 to 5 hours overlapping US Pacific business hours, about 8:30 pm to 1:30 am IST.
* Process: screening questions, a short written technical questionnaire, then one live technical call with our leadership team.

**What you will do**

* Build and maintain custom Shopify apps with the Shopify CLI, the React Router app template, App Bridge and Polaris.
* Write Shopify Functions for discount, delivery and payment customizations, and build Checkout UI extensions with our front-end developer.
* Integrate stores with ERPs, OMS, CRMs, subscription and payment platforms (Recharge, Klaviyo, NetSuite and others) through APIs, webhooks and middleware.
* Run replatforming projects from Magento, WooCommerce, OpenCart and custom platforms: products, customers, orders, redirects and SEO continuity.
* Model client data with metafields and metaobjects, and automate operations with Shopify Flow and the Admin GraphQL API.
* Write technical specs and estimates, review code, and support launches with logging and error tracking.

**Required**

* 5+ years of backend development, including 2+ years building on Shopify or Shopify Plus.
* Strong Node.js and TypeScript; REST and GraphQL API design.
* Deep Shopify Admin GraphQL API knowledge: bulk operations, rate limits, webhooks, app auth (OAuth, session tokens), app extensions.
* Shopify Functions and Checkout Extensibility shipped to live stores.
* Large data migrations with Matrixify or your own scripts.
* SQL, an ORM such as Prisma, and background jobs and queues.
* Cloud deployment (AWS, GCP, Fly.io or similar), Docker, CI/CD and Git.
* Clear written English. You will explain trade-offs directly to US clients.

**Nice to have**

* PHP and Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce.
* Shopify B2B, Markets, and Hydrogen / Oxygen headless builds.
* Celigo, Make or Zapier; HubSpot or Zoho.
* Agency experience across several concurrent clients.

**How to apply**

Apply on LinkedIn and answer the screening questions. Include your GitHub profile, or your Shopify Partner or App Store link if you have one. Shortlisted candidates receive a short written questionnaire within 3 working days.

title: Shopify Theme Developer (Liquid, Online Store 2.0)
description:
Adella is a US-based ecommerce agency that builds Shopify storefronts for US brands. We are hiring a front-end developer to build and maintain Shopify themes. You will work with our in-house designer to turn Figma designs into fast, accessible storefronts that merchants can edit themselves in the theme editor.

**The basics, up front**

* Full-time and remote from anywhere in India.
* Engage as an independent contractor or as an employee. Tell us which you prefer.
* Competitive pay, paid monthly in INR.
* Working hours: 4 to 5 hours overlapping US Pacific business hours, about 8:30 pm to 1:30 am IST.
* Process: screening questions, a short written technical questionnaire, then one live technical call with our leadership team.

**What you will do**

* Build custom themes and extend existing ones (Horizon, Dawn and premium themes) with Liquid, sections, theme blocks and JSON templates.
* Turn Figma files into responsive, pixel-accurate pages with merchant-friendly settings, and flag build or performance concerns during design.
* Build Checkout and Customer Account UI extensions with our backend developer.
* Integrate storefront apps: Recharge, reviews, search and filtering, Klaviyo forms, GA4 and tag management.
* Keep stores fast: Core Web Vitals, image and script loading, app bloat.
* Meet WCAG 2.2 AA and run cross-browser and device QA.
* Work in Git with the Shopify CLI, Theme Check, the GitHub integration and preview themes.

**Required**

* 3+ years of front-end development, including 2+ years shipping Online Store 2.0 themes.
* Expert Liquid, semantic HTML, CSS (SCSS or Tailwind) and modern JavaScript (ES modules, web components).
* Theme architecture: sections, theme blocks, snippets, settings schema, metafields and metaobjects.
* Shopify storefront APIs: Ajax Cart API, Section Rendering API, Storefront API basics.
* Shipped work that shows performance and accessibility skill.
* 2 to 3 live Shopify stores you built or substantially worked on.

**Nice to have**

* React, for checkout extensions and Hydrogen storefronts.
* Shopify Plus: Markets, B2B, multiple stores.
* Working from Figma components and a design system; motion and micro-interactions.
* Agency experience across several concurrent clients.

**How to apply**

Apply on LinkedIn and answer the screening questions. In your application, list 2 to 3 live Shopify store URLs and state exactly what you built on each. Applications without live store links are not reviewed.

title: LLM Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
LLM Full Stack Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Develop and integrate applications with Large Language Models (LLMs) and other enterprise services. Leverage front-end and server-side technologies to develop APIs, implement DevOps practices, and optimize Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Large Language Models (LLMs)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
6 to 10 years of overall experience including 3 years in Python backend cloud integration or platform engineering
  
  
Summary:
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Gemini Enterprise Engineer to build, integrate, deploy, and operate enterprise AI solutions using Gemini Enterprise, Google Cloud, Vertex AI, enterprise search, and agent platforms. The role will deliver secure, scalable, and production-ready enterprise search, knowledge assistants, copilots, and AI agents that respect user permissions and meet agreed quality, reliability, performance, and cost targets.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
AI Solution Development
  
  
Configure and develop Gemini Enterprise applications, data stores, connectors, and custom ingestion services validate metadata, refresh, deletion, and access-control behavior.
  
  
Build Python services, Gemini and Vertex AI integrations, and agents using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or an appropriate framework, including prompts, structured outputs, tool calls, workflow state, approvals, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
Translate solution designs and business requirements into maintainable, scalable, and testable technical implementations.
  
  
Enterprise Search, RAG & Agents
  
  
Build and tune RAG pipelines covering document parsing, chunking, embeddings, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and source attribution.
  
  
Diagnose and resolve missing, stale, unauthorized, or poorly ranked evidence and improve retrieval and answer quality.
  
  
Develop and deploy custom and multi-agent workflows, tool integrations, and enterprise automation using supported Gemini Enterprise integration patterns.
  
  
Integration, Security & Governance
  
  
Integrate enterprise APIs, databases, SaaS products, and line-of-business applications using secure and resilient patterns, including authentication, scoped permissions, validation, retries, timeouts, and duplicate-action prevention.
  
  
Implement IAM, service identities, OAuth, secrets management, source-level permissions, least-privilege access, and secure environment separation.
  
  
Apply Responsible AI, security, privacy, auditability, and governance controls, including protection against prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized retrieval, and unsafe actions.
  
  
Evaluation, DevOps & Production Support
  
  
Create automated and human evaluation approaches for grounding, relevance, safety, hallucination management, agent effectiveness, and task completion.
  
  
Implement automated quality, security, and regression tests maintain CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration and prompt versioning, and release controls.
  
  
Instrument logging, tracing, monitoring, latency, consumption, and cost troubleshoot failures, optimize production performance, and support releases and incidents.
  
  
Engineering Leadership
  
  
Conduct design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and promote maintainable engineering standards across Python services, APIs, retrieval pipelines, agents, and cloud-native components.
  
  
Create reusable patterns, accelerators, templates, operational documentation, and reference implementations while ensuring alignment with approved architecture.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  
Google Cloud and Enterprise AI
  
  
Hands-on Google Cloud delivery experience, including Gemini or Vertex AI APIs and suitable application hosting such as Cloud Run or an agent runtime.
  
  
Practical experience configuring or developing enterprise AI, search, knowledge-assistant, copilot, or agent solutions.
  
  
Software, Search and Agent Engineering
  
  
Strong Python and API development skills, with working knowledge of SQL, JSON, Git, automated testing, error handling, and maintainable service design.
  
  
Practical RAG or enterprise-search implementation experience and understanding of document processing, embeddings, retrieval quality, grounding, structured outputs, and prompt engineering.
  
  
Experience with tool-using LLM applications, agent orchestration, workflow state, function calling, and enterprise-system integrations.
  
  
Security, DevOps and Operations
  
  
Working knowledge of IAM, SSO, OAuth, service identities, secrets, source-level permissions, and testing of unauthorized access scenarios.
  
  
Experience with containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, logging, tracing, monitoring, and supporting a deployed service beyond a demonstration.
  
  
Understanding of LLMOps practices, including evaluation pipelines, prompt and configuration management, regression testing, release governance, and production monitoring.
  
  
Collaboration and Technical Leadership
  
  
Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with architects, product teams, security teams, and business stakeholders.
  
  
Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing technical deliverables, and working in agile and geographically distributed delivery teams.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Direct Gemini Enterprise or Google Agentspace configuration and implementation experience.
  
  
Google ADK, production agent runtimes, Vertex AI Search or Discovery Engine APIs, and MCP or A2A integrations.
  
  
LangGraph, LangChain, multi-agent orchestration, enterprise knowledge management, taxonomy, ontology, or knowledge-graph solutions.
  
  
GenAI evaluation, observability, safety, governance, or Responsible AI frameworks.
  
  
Relevant Google Cloud, GenAI, or AI engineering certification.
  
  
Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in Large Language Models (LLMs).
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* 6 to 10 years of overall experience including 3 years in Python backend cloud integration or platform engineering is required.

Large Language Models (LLMs)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA

Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
AI Solution Development
  
  
Configure and develop Gemini Enterprise applications, data stores, connectors, and custom ingestion services validate metadata, refresh, deletion, and access-control behavior.
  
  
Build Python services, Gemini and Vertex AI integrations, and agents using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or an appropriate framework, including prompts, structured outputs, tool calls, workflow state, approvals, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
Translate solution designs and business requirements into maintainable, scalable, and testable technical implementations.
  
  
Enterprise Search, RAG & Agents
  
  
Build and tune RAG pipelines covering document parsing, chunking, embeddings, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and source attribution.
  
  
Diagnose and resolve missing, stale, unauthorized, or poorly ranked evidence and improve retrieval and answer quality.
  
  
Develop and deploy custom and multi-agent workflows, tool integrations, and enterprise automation using supported Gemini Enterprise integration patterns.
  
  
Integration, Security & Governance
  
  
Integrate enterprise APIs, databases, SaaS products, and line-of-business applications using secure and resilient patterns, including authentication, scoped permissions, validation, retries, timeouts, and duplicate-action prevention.
  
  
Implement IAM, service identities, OAuth, secrets management, source-level permissions, least-privilege access, and secure environment separation.
  
  
Apply Responsible AI, security, privacy, auditability, and governance controls, including protection against prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized retrieval, and unsafe actions.
  
  
Evaluation, DevOps & Production Support
  
  
Create automated and human evaluation approaches for grounding, relevance, safety, hallucination management, agent effectiveness, and task completion.
  
  
Implement automated quality, security, and regression tests maintain CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration and prompt versioning, and release controls.
  
  
Instrument logging, tracing, monitoring, latency, consumption, and cost troubleshoot failures, optimize production performance, and support releases and incidents.
  
  
Engineering Leadership
  
  
Conduct design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and promote maintainable engineering standards across Python services, APIs, retrieval pipelines, agents, and cloud-native components.
  
  
Create reusable patterns, accelerators, templates, operational documentation, and reference implementations while ensuring alignment with approved architecture.

Google Cloud and Enterprise AI
  
  
Hands-on Google Cloud delivery experience, including Gemini or Vertex AI APIs and suitable application hosting such as Cloud Run or an agent runtime.
  
  
Practical experience configuring or developing enterprise AI, search, knowledge-assistant, copilot, or agent solutions.
  
  
Software, Search and Agent Engineering
  
  
Strong Python and API development skills, with working knowledge of SQL, JSON, Git, automated testing, error handling, and maintainable service design.
  
  
Practical RAG or enterprise-search implementation experience and understanding of document processing, embeddings, retrieval quality, grounding, structured outputs, and prompt engineering.
  
  
Experience with tool-using LLM applications, agent orchestration, workflow state, function calling, and enterprise-system integrations.
  
  
Security, DevOps and Operations
  
  
Working knowledge of IAM, SSO, OAuth, service identities, secrets, source-level permissions, and testing of unauthorized access scenarios.
  
  
Experience with containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, logging, tracing, monitoring, and supporting a deployed service beyond a demonstration.

Translate solution designs and business requirements into maintainable, scalable, and testable technical implementations.
  
  
Enterprise Search, RAG & Agents
  
  
Build and tune RAG pipelines covering document parsing, chunking, embeddings, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and source attribution.
  
  
Diagnose and resolve missing, stale, unauthorized, or poorly ranked evidence and improve retrieval and answer quality.
